subject: Demo recap & proposed 4-week POC: evaluation plan, KPIs, owners (NexaWorks)
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nexaworks.com>, NexaWorks Technical <infra@nexaworks.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Demo recap & proposed 4-week POC: evaluation plan, KPIs, owners (NexaWorks)

Thanks again for your time today — really enjoyed the discussion and the clear signal that NexaWorks is ready to validate Redwood for your search-assist workflows. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we can lock calendars and owners.

TL;DR (proposal)
- 4-week POC starting the week of Jun 19
- Objectives: validate accuracy on your intent-classifier + semantic-match pipeline, measure latency/throughput under production-like load, and estimate unit costs at scale
- Success criteria (minimal pass): intent classification F1 >= 0.90 on NexaWorks test set; p95 latency <= 350ms (single-region); 90% of top-5 suggestions match internal relevance labels

Proposed evaluation plan (week-by-week)
1) Week 0 (prep, pre-kickoff) — Deliverables: test dataset template, baseline metrics, network prep (VPC peering options)
2) Week 1 (kickoff & ingest) — Deploy trial environment (hosted/dedicated mix), ingest sample dataset (~10k prompts), run smoke tests
3) Week 2 (load & quality) — Run 3 load profiles (low/typical/peak), collect latency/throughput, run labeled accuracy evals on subset; iterate prompt templates
4) Week 3 (edge cases & reliability) — Run longer sessions, cache-warm experiments, measure token costs, document failure modes
5) Week 4 (wrap & deliverables) — Final metrics, recommendations (batching, quantization), handoff plan and commercial proposal

KPIs / success metrics
- Intent F1 >= 0.90 on provided labeled set
- p95 latency <= 350ms for 1k-token distribution
- Sustained throughput >= 12 RPS for 4 concurrent sessions (example load)
- Cost estimate: unit cost per 1M tokens and delta vs current vendor
- No regressions on 10 prioritized prompts (binary pass/fail)

Owners / contacts
- Redwood AE: Chloe Martin (me) — overall POC owner, cadence and commercial
- Redwood Solutions: Ben Carter — environment & runbook, observability hooks
- Redwood Reliability: Aditya Rao — model selection, perf tuning
- NexaWorks Technical: Elena Morales / infra@nexaworks.com — dataset and acceptance labels

Logistics / security notes
- We can run the trial in hosted mode (Redwood cloud) or in your VPC via Redwood Private. For the POC we recommend hosted with a dedicated capacity slice to get to realistic throughput quickly; if you need VPC we can standby to spin up a Private eval.
- Attached: NexaWorks-POC-Checklist.xlsx (template), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC2 artifact extract).

Next steps (please reply with):
1) Confirm go/no-go for week of Jun 19
2) Which dataset owner will provide the labeled F1 set? (file/owner/email)
3) Any hard constraints we should account for (residency/SOC2-only, IP restrictions)

Happy to schedule a 30-min kickoff for Jun 19 or Jun 20 — I have availability 10-12 PT both days.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed 4-week POC: evaluation plan, KPIs, owners (NexaWorks)

Thanks Chloe — appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifying items before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Data residency & compliance: our security team requires SOC2 evidence and confirmation that test data will not leave the US for this POC. Can you confirm the hosted option is US-only and share the SOC2 summary (we need a short evidence pack)?
2) Test data: we have a 12k-record labeled set plus a 3k unlabeled stream. Is the template able to accept CSV with a label column? Any PII handling guidance?
3) Throughput: our realistic peak is ~14 RPS during business hours but spikes to 22 RPS during promotions. Will the dedicated slice handle that without manual ops?

Also adding Markus (infra@nexaworks.com) who will own the network/setup. Once we have the SOC2 artifacts and quick answers on residency and data format we can confirm Jun 19 kickoff.

- Elena
VP, Product, NexaWorks

Hi Elena / Markus — thanks for the questions. Looping in Ben and Aditya to cover ops and perf detail. Answers below: 

1) Residency & SOC2: hosted POC environments can be pinned to US-only regions (us-east-1 / us-west-2). redwood-soc2-summary.pdf is attached to this thread (we included the SOC2 scope page and contact for the auditor). If you need the full SOC2 report we can share via an NDA/secure link — we typically provide the auditor package to security teams.

2) Test data format: CSV with a label column is perfect. Please use the attached NexaWorks-POC-Checklist.xlsx for column naming (prompt_text, context, expected_label, priority_flag). For PII, strip any direct identifiers; if you must include examples with sensitive tokens, mark them and we’ll use a masked ingestion path.

3) Throughput & capacity: for the stated peak (22 RPS) we recommend the dedicated slice during Week 2-3. The Redwood Dedicated slices are pre-provisioned; autoscaling can be configured but we’ll need to agree on burst policy. For the POC we can provision a 1.5x headroom slice so you see realistic behavior without manual intervention. Ben — can you confirm the proposed slice sizing and a rough cost delta for a 4-week trial?

Proposed kickoff: Jun 20, 2028 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT) — if that works I’ll book a calendar invite and include a quick runbook. 

Deliverables updated: we’ll add an explicit runbook with acceptance tests (smoke, load, accuracy).

Thanks — Chloe
